typeName: Rate in context from a table
title: Sand delivered to a construction site

stimulus.title: Sand delivered to a construction site
stimulus.html:
Sand is delivered to a construction site at a rate S(t)S(t) tons per hour, where tt is measured in hours and 0≤t≤80 \le t \le 8. SS is differentiable. Selected values of S(t)S(t) are shown in the table. For parts (d) and (e), the rate is modeled by M(t)=4+3.2sin⁡(t3)M(t) = 4 + 3.2\sin\left(\frac{t}{3}\right) tons per hour.
Rate S(t), in tons per hour, at selected times t, in hours
tt (hours)01468
S(t)S(t) (tons per hour)4.05.17.16.95.4

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Use a right Riemann sum with the four subintervals indicated by the table to approximate ∫08S(t)dt\int_0^8 S(t)\,dt. Show the computations that lead to your answer, and indicate units of measure.

rubric.point: A right Riemann sum with widths 1, 3, 2 and 2
accept: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5.1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>7.1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6.9</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5.4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1(5.1) + 3(7.1) + 2(6.9) + 2(5.4)</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>8</mn></msubsup><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^8 S(t)\,dt</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>≈</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5.1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>7.1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6.9</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5.4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx 1(5.1) + 3(7.1) + 2(6.9) + 2(5.4)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>5.1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>21.3</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>13.8</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>10.8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 5.1 + 21.3 + 13.8 + 10.8</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>51.0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 51.0</annotation></semantics></math> tons.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Explain the meaning of ∫08S(t)dt\int_0^8 S(t)\,dt in the context of the problem.

rubric.point: The total tons of sand delivered to the site from <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 0</annotation></semantics></math> to <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 8</annotation></semantics></math> hours
accept: must name the quantity, the units (tons) and the interval

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>8</mn></msubsup><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^8 S(t)\,dt</annotation></semantics></math> is the total amount of sand, in tons, delivered to the construction site from <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 0</annotation></semantics></math> to <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 8</annotation></semantics></math> hours.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Must there be a time tt, 1<t<41 < t < 4, at which S(t)=6S(t) = 6? Justify your answer.

rubric.point: States <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>5.1</mn><mo><</mo><mn>6</mn><mo><</mo><mn>7.1</mn><mo>=</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S(1) = 5.1 < 6 < 7.1 = S(4)</annotation></semantics></math>

Concludes yes by the Intermediate Value Theorem, stating that <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>S</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S</annotation></semantics></math> is continuous because it is differentiable
accept: "<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>S</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S</annotation></semantics></math> is differentiable, so it is continuous on <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[1, 4]</annotation></semantics></math>; by the IVT ..."

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>S</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S</annotation></semantics></math> is differentiable, so it is continuous on <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[1, 4]</annotation></semantics></math>. <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>5.1</mn><mo><</mo><mn>6</mn><mo><</mo><mn>7.1</mn><mo>=</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S(1) = 5.1 < 6 < 7.1 = S(4)</annotation></semantics></math>. By the Intermediate Value Theorem, there is a time <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math> with <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo><</mo><mi>t</mi><mo><</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1 < t < 4</annotation></semantics></math> at which <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S(t) = 6</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Using the model MM, find the total amount of sand delivered from t=0t = 0 to t=8t = 8 hours.

rubric.point: The integral <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>8</mn></msubsup><mi>M</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^8 M(t)\,dt</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>8</mn></msubsup><mi>M</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^8 M(t)\,dt</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>≈</mo><mn>50.138</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx 50.138</annotation></semantics></math> tons (calculator, radian mode).

parts.label: e
parts.prompt: Using the model MM, find the time TT at which the total amount of sand delivered since t=0t = 0 reaches 25 tons.

rubric.point: An equation: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mi>T</mi></msubsup><mi>M</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>25</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^T M(t)\,dt = 25</annotation></semantics></math>
accept: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mi>T</mi></msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>3.2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^T \left(4 + 3.2\sin\frac{t}{3}\right)dt</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>25</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 25</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: Solve <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mi>T</mi></msubsup><mi>M</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>25</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^T M(t)\,dt = 25</annotation></semantics></math> with the calculator: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>4.232</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T \approx 4.232</annotation></semantics></math> hours. (Since <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M(t) > 0</annotation></semantics></math>, the total delivered increases, so this is the only such time.)
